evidence.title: An invariant reference can isolate additive drift
evidence.summary: A conditional construction on matched observations. It assumes the reference is unaffected by the environmental component.
evidence.scope: Additive synthetic construction; matched observed pairs
evidence.body:
FICTIONAL RESEARCH MEMORY

Hypothesis: if a reference measures the same environmental component as a sensor while remaining invariant to that sensor’s drift, matched differences can isolate an additive drift component.

This is a conditional algebraic construction. It assumes matched observations and the stated reference invariance. No field-data result or scientific acceptance is recorded.

evidence.title: Selective gaps break the population inference
evidence.summary: A mask correlated with reference values changes the observed support. A paired statement cannot silently become a population statement.
evidence.scope: Selective missingness in the synthetic construction
evidence.body:
FICTIONAL RESEARCH MEMORY

Counterexample outline: two environments agree on the observed support but differ on unobserved conditions. A mask selects observations by reference value. The available matched pairs cannot distinguish the two population descriptions.

Consequence: the observed-pair construction does not establish population identifiability under selective missingness. This gap remains open.

evidence.summary: The scope revision must preserve the original question and its missing-information gap.
evidence.body:

evidence.summary: Hold the latent signal and mask fixed to distinguish reference confounding from fixture behavior. Planning does not authorize execution.

FICTIONAL RESEARCH MEMORY

Plan: hold the synthetic latent signal and observation support fixed, then compare invariant and co-varying reference conditions. Predict that reference confounding can persist after a fixture shape correction.

An implementation-dependent difference would redirect engineering diagnosis. A difference tied to the reference condition would support the mechanism distinction only within this construction. No experiment is authorized by this plan.
